data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small net gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 3.1m ( -0.64% of opening gross claims outstanding) based on the gross claims development table. The Managing Agent also reports a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 14.6m net of reinsurance recoveries, comprising releases in direct Third Party Liability and reinsurance business partially offset by a strengthening across other classes. Primary movements related to favourable claims development (releases) in Casualty/Third Party Liability and small releases in Reinsurance, with some adverse development in other classes. Recent 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) is discussed in the report but relates to current-year catastrophe losses rather than prior-year reserve movement.

data.data_quality_notes: The Movement in prior year's provision note provides a net (after reinsurance) favourable development of GBP 14.6m but does not present a gross (insurance liabilities) total. A gross prior-year movement was therefore calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) table (pages 35-36) excluding the aggregated '2010 & prior' column; that triangle-derived gross PYD is a small release of ~GBP 3.14m. The net note and the gross triangle differ; the gross triangle was used as the authoritative gross movement per extraction rules. Component breakdowns in the movement note appear to be stated but are presented in the context of net of reinsurance; interpretation of whether component numbers are gross or net is ambiguous in the note.
